headingRule.note: Standard card heading is 36 (sm/lg tier). A single word or <=3-word punchy phrase carrying the card -> 48 Semi Bold 110% (skip 40); canonical examples: pillar-grid-3up-functional, numbered-list. Small cards keep their tier headings (xs 24, sm-compact 28); hero 56. 32 is a retired deviation.

typography.statRowException: A 4-column stat row always uses sm tier regardless of height (label 24 / body 24).

statCardException.note: Cards with a dominant impact number (64px+) use 32px X padding instead of the tier default of 48px. Y padding (48px top/bottom) is unchanged.
statCardException.appliesWhen: heading or impact number is 64px or larger and dominates the card visually

body.note: Supporting copy: 28 Medium 134% Gray/500. Under the title: 15px below it (y=200), content width. Beside the title (top-right header paragraph): top-aligned with the title at y=115, fixed right column 587px wide flush to x=1872 (starts x=1285), left-aligned; title left region caps at ~1205px. Retired: the 32px subtitle and 20px deck deviations. Source of truth: Template references pillar-grid-3up-* frames.

heroBody.note: Primary slide text with no competing 64px title (e.g. full-bleed-hero, pillar-grid-large-image). Steps up from the 28px supporting body.

listRow.note: Tabular/list content. Uses its own smaller scale — one step below lg — so rows read tabular, not card-like.

cardMarker.note: Single marker at the top of a card; matches the card's label size.

denseMarker.note: Marker inside a bullet list, list-row, or stacked ordinal list; one typescale notch smaller than the surrounding body.

textNodeNaming.rule: Name text nodes by role, not content. Do not reuse 'label' for what is actually a 'heading'. Top-of-slide chrome is named 'meta-left' and 'meta-right' (NOT 'meta').

chromePositioning.note: Content is pinned at y=287 regardless of title length. Card height is always 745. Title→content gap is variable (~102 for 1-row title at 64/110%, ~32 for 2-row). No bottom meta — last content element's bottom edge lands at y=1032 (48px from slide bottom). Slot names are 'meta-left', 'meta-right', 'title' — applyChrome() writes these at the positions above.

impact.note: Step heading up one size on the typescale when content is a single dramatic number or 3-word punchy phrase. Max one impact element per card, max one hero per slide. The values below are concrete targets per tier.

templatePages.name: Templates 4
templatePages.note: Retired 2026-05-29. All generator templates were harmonized and moved to 'Template references'. Do NOT route to this page; kept for historical reference only.

slideContract.note: The canonical geometry every GENERATED content slide must satisfy. A template frame is NOT trusted to be correct — audit the OUTPUT against this after every build (see design-system.md -> auditFrame/auditSlide). Heroes/covers/closing/custom layouts are exempt (see exemptKinds).
slideContract.raisedCardNote: Headline-clear vertical fill: a card/column horizontally clear of the headline ink (left edge ≥ one 32px gutter to the right of the eyebrow/title glyphs) may raise its top from contentTopY (287) to raisedCardTopY (115), growing to raisedCardHeight (917). Still bottom-anchors to lastElementBottomY (1032). The column under the headline keeps 287/745. Judge clearance by visible glyph extent, not the title frame width. See design-system.md → 'Headline-clear vertical fill'.

headline.note: Multi-line titles: (1) balanceTitle — set title box to the narrowest width that keeps the same line count (lc=round(height/(fontSize*1.10))); binary-search width in [ceil(1824/lc),1824]; kills widows, evens rows; skip 1-line titles. (2) dynamic gap — contentTop=max(287, titleBottom+52); content region height=1032-contentTop; re-justify bottom-anchored content. (3) eyebrow optional (drop to reclaim ~47px). See design-system.md 'Headline wrap & dynamic gap'.

bodyMeasure.note: Body/paragraph width must yield 45-75 chars/line (66 ideal). charAdvance(px)=0.472*fontSize; width(px)=cpl*0.472*fontSize. fitBody(slotWidth,size): if slot>=idealW set width=idealW (cap at maxW, never full-bleed); if minW<=slot<idealW use slot; if slot<minW step size DOWN until minW<=slot, else use fewer/wider columns, else shorten to caption. Never hardcode a body width. See design-system.md 'Body copy measure'.
bodyMeasure.footnoteNote: Footnotes/source-notes/slide-level captions are NOT body copy — never run fitBody on them. Render full content width (x=48, width=1824), Suisse Int'l Regular 14, Gray/500 #71717a, textAlignHorizontal CENTER (or LEFT), textAutoResize=HEIGHT, bottom-anchored y=1032-height (~994). May exceed 75 cpl on one line. Canonical: financial-report-06 'footnote'. See design-system.md 'Footnote / source-note exemption'.
